theater: 黎巴嫩南部與以色列北部

battle.name: 黎巴嫩戰爭
battle.theater: 黎巴嫩南部與以色列北部
battle.brief: 二〇〇六年七月十二日，真主黨在舍巴農莊一帶襲擊以軍巡邏隊並擄走兩名士兵，以色列當夜以空襲與砲火回應，地面部隊其後深入南黎，最後在安理會一七〇一號決議下停火。卡面那門一八五〇年的線膛砲早已退役，但它定下的群砲射程壓過步兵的規矩，在本役化成以軍十七萬發砲彈對上真主黨近四千發火箭砲。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰主體只有兩邊：以色列國防軍，與真主黨。以方由總理艾胡德·奧爾默特拍板，國防部長阿米爾·佩雷茨掌軍務，參謀長丹·哈魯茲坐鎮中央司令部；北方司令部由烏迪·亞當中將直接指揮藍線一線的作戰，南方司令部由摩謝·卡普林斯基中將接手，率裝甲兵與步兵師縱深推進，另有工兵、機動部隊與後勤單位支援，最高峰時以軍在黎境投入的兵力約一萬人至三萬人之間；海空兩軍同時運作，空軍負責縱深打擊，海軍則沿黎巴嫩海岸執行海空封鎖。真主黨一方不是國家軍隊，而是以黎巴嫩南部為根據地的武裝組織，首都貝魯特設有政治機構，南部山區由各支部作戰單位分區防守，阿慕拉運動、黎巴嫩共產黨、巴勒斯坦解放組織人民鬥爭總部、敘利亞社會民族黨等組織亦有人南部助戰；敘利亞與伊朗是背後的軍火與資金來源，敘軍二〇〇五年撤出黎巴嫩後，真主黨在邊境一線反而縮短了補給距離。黎巴嫩軍約六萬人分散全國，戰時保持中立不作抵抗，聯合國駐黎部隊在戰時兵力極少，藍線全靠雙方自行維繫。以方在十六日的內閣聲明中即把戰爭對象界定為受敘伊支持的真主黨武裝，而不是黎巴嫩國家本身，試圖把戰事與黎巴嫩主權問題切割開來。
countriesEn: There were only two main belligerents: the Israel Defense Forces and Hezbollah. On the Israeli side Prime Minister Ehud Olmert made the decisions, Defense Minister Amir Peretz ran the war business, and Chief of Staff Dan Halutz sat in the central command. The Northern Command under Major General Udi Adam handled the fighting directly along the Blue Line, the Southern Command under Major General Moshe Kaplinsky took over the deep ground advance with armour and infantry, backed by engineers, mobile forces and logistics units; the number of Israeli troops committed in Lebanon at the peak was somewhere between ten thousand and thirty thousand. The air and sea services worked at the same time, the air force responsible for strikes in depth, the navy enforcing an air-and-sea blockade along the Lebanese coast. Hezbollah was not a state army but an armed organisation based in southern Lebanon, with its political institutions in Beirut and its combat units holding sectors of the southern hills, and the Amal Movement, the Lebanese Communist Party, the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command and the Syrian Social Nationalist Party also had members fighting in the south. Syria and Iran were the sources of arms and money behind it, and after the Syrian withdrawal from Lebanon in 2005 Hezbollah actually shortened its supply lines along the border. The Lebanese Armed Forces, some sixty thousand strong, were dispersed across the whole country and stayed neutral without resisting, the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon was a token presence during the fighting, and the Blue Line was kept by the two sides themselves. On the sixteenth the Israeli cabinet communiqué defined the object of the war as the Syrian- and Iranian-backed Hezbollah armed wing rather than the Lebanese state, an attempt to cut the fighting off from the question of Lebanese sovereignty.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊。以軍方面，總理艾胡德·奧爾默特在七月十二日深夜的內閣會議上決定以大規模軍事行動回應擄人事件，付出的代價是此役自始缺少明確的終局方案與退出策略，後來被認定為失誤根源；國防部長阿米爾·佩雷茨負責軍令推進，參謀長丹·哈魯茲同時捱住兵變與輿論壓力，其後於二〇〇七年一月辭職；北方司令部司令烏迪·亞當中將是邊線作戰的實際主持者，南方司令部司令摩謝·卡普林斯基中將率軍攻入南部山區，裝甲旅長阿里昂·弗里德曼在七月二十四日的馬倫拉斯戰鬥中下令抓捕真主黨人員，成為以軍在本役的第一批俘獲。軍內的反面聲音同樣有分量：教育總監伊蘭·哈拉里少將、副參謀長伊夫塔·龍塔爾少將公開判斷以軍並沒有贏，龍塔爾隨即被解職。戰後的溫諾格拉德委員會由退休法官埃利亞胡·溫諾格拉德主持，前參謀長阿姆農·利普金-沙哈克主持軍方調查，前摩薩德局長納胡姆·阿德莫尼主持政治調查，報告把本役定性為錯失的機會。真主黨方面，領袖哈桑·納斯魯拉在開戰前一年半已公開承諾要擄走以軍人質，開戰後卻宣稱不應為擄人行動承擔戰爭責任，同時承認整場戰爭早已在計畫之中；軍事組織領袖伊馬德·穆格尼耶實際調度全線，南部指揮官納比勒·卡奧克在提爾的空襲中陣亡，賓特朱拜勒地區的作戰指揮哈立德·巴茲於七月二十九日陣亡。聯合國秘書長科菲·安南在停火與封鎖問題上屢次指責以軍，黎巴嫩總理福阿德·西尼奧拉則宣稱沒有主權國家就無從處理真主黨的武裝。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall on two sides. In the Israeli camp, Prime Minister Ehud Olmert decided at a late-night cabinet meeting on 12 July to answer the seizure of soldiers with large-scale military action; the price was that the campaign never had a defined end-state or an exit strategy, which later became the accepted explanation for the failure. Defense Minister Amir Peretz drove the operational chain of command, Chief of Staff Dan Halutz bore the mutiny and the public criticism at the same time and resigned in January 2007. Northern Command commander Major General Udi Adam was the man actually running the fighting on the line, and Southern Command commander Major General Moshe Kaplinsky led the forces into the southern hills. Armoured brigade commander Alon Friedman ordered the capture of Hezbollah personnel in the fighting at Maroun al-Ras on 24 July, the first Israeli prisoners of the war. Dissent inside the IDF carried weight too: education branch chief Brigadier General Ilan Harari and deputy chief of staff Major General Yiftah Ron-Tal said publicly that the IDF had not won, and Ron-Tal was immediately dismissed. The post-war Winograd Commission was chaired by the retired judge Eliyahu Winograd, with former chief of staff Amnon Lipkin-Shahak leading the military line of inquiry and former Mossad director Nahum Admoni leading the political one; the report called the campaign a missed opportunity. On the Hezbollah side, leader Hassan Nasrallah had publicly pledged a year and a half before the war to seize Israeli soldiers, then after the outbreak argued that the war should not be blamed on the seizure while admitting that the whole war had long been planned. The military commander Imad Mughniyeh actually ran the front, the southern commander Nabil Qaouk was killed in the strike on Tyre, and the operations commander of the Bint Jbeil area, Khalid Bazzi, was killed on 29 July. UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan repeatedly faulted Israel over the ceasefire and the blockade, while Lebanese Prime Minister Fouad Siniora argued that without a sovereign state there was no way to deal with the Hezbollah weapons.
kits: 卡面那門一八五〇年的德國線膛野戰砲本身並沒有出現在本役，它是血統上的祖先，不是戰場裝備。一八五〇年前後，普魯士與德意志諸邦的野戰砲正由前裝轉為後裝、由實心彈轉為爆炸彈，線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步兵，這個觀念正是本役雙方火力對比的底層邏輯。以軍的直系後代是成建制的間接火力：M109「帕拉丁」155毫米自走榴彈砲、自走多管火箭發射系統，部署在邊境線上的成排155毫米榴彈砲，以及海軍艦炮，全部以群射方式覆蓋南部山區的反坦克陣地與火箭發射場；配合AH-64「長弓」攻擊直升機與赫爾墨斯四五〇型無人機作偵察與定點清除，F-15I與F-16I負責制空與對地遮斷，地面主力是配備反裝甲反應裝置的梅卡瓦主戰坦克，空軍同時投下大量集束彈。真主黨一側的對應物是火箭砲：122毫米「卡秋莎」BM-21與63式發射車、Type-81與Type-90集束火箭彈、射程更遠的「法塔赫」三型與「澤勒扎爾二型」中程火箭、伊朗製「拉阿德一型」反坦克導彈、240毫米迫擊砲，加上技術車改裝的機槍陣與自製路障炸藥，步槍以AK-47為主。軍火全部來自敘利亞、伊朗、俄羅斯與中國的庫存；真主黨在本役之前估計握有一萬三千至一萬五千枚火箭與導彈，是自二〇〇三年以來第一次把整個火箭砲兵團投入持續作戰。
kitsEn: The 1850 German rifled field gun on the card never appeared in this war: it is an ancestor by lineage, not a piece of equipment on the battlefield. Around 1850 the field guns of Prussia and the German states were shifting from muzzle-loading to breech-loading and from solid shot to explosive shells, and the rifled bore let the same charge of powder carry further, giving artillery for the first time a range edge over infantry. That idea is the underlying logic behind the fire contest of this campaign. The direct descendant on the Israeli side was massed indirect fire: M109 Paladin 155 mm self-propelled howitzers, self-propelled multiple rocket launchers, rows of 155 mm tube artillery deployed along the border line, and naval guns, all used in salvo to cover the anti-tank positions and rocket firing sites of the southern hills. AH-64 Longbow attack helicopters and Hermes 450 unmanned aircraft provided reconnaissance and precision removal, F-15I and F-16I fighters handled air superiority and the interdiction of the ground, the main battle force on the ground was Merkava tanks fitted with reactive armour blocks, and the air force dropped large quantities of cluster munitions. The Hezbollah counterpart was rocket artillery: 122 mm Katyusha BM-21 and 63-series launchers, Type-81 and Type-90 cluster rockets, the longer-ranged Fajr-3 and Zelzal-2 medium-range rockets, the Iranian Ra'ad-1 anti-tank missile, 240 mm mortars, machine-gun mounts welded onto technicals and homemade roadblock charges, with the AK-47 as the standard rifle. All the matériel came out of Syrian, Iranian, Russian and Chinese stocks, and Hezbollah was estimated to hold thirteen to fifteen thousand rockets and missiles before the war: the first time since its rebuilding in 2003 that it committed an entire rocket artillery force to continuous operations.
tactics: 以軍的戰術是典型的縱深火力加地面推進三段式。第一段是火力準備：七月十二日白晝真主黨在舍巴農莊發動跨境襲擊，以軍當日黃昏即用邊境榴彈砲與空襲回應，第二日凌晨展開代號「密度」的空中行動，據以方說法在三十四分鐘內摧毀五十九個中程火箭發射架，隨後數日又打掉大批「澤勒扎爾二型」；情報部門預先列好的八十三個目標，到開戰第四日已全部打完。第二段是地面推進：以步兵與裝甲協同，先沿藍線推入南部縱深，在馬倫拉斯一線與真主黨逐村爭奪，二十四日以軍抓獲兩名真主黨戰士，隨後向利塔尼河方向推進。第三段是停火前夕仍舊發動的大規模地面攻勢，維諾格拉德委員會批評這一仗從未在方案與退路之間作出選擇。真主黨的戰術是分散、機動、游擊：用卡車當發射車，打完即撤；火箭砲每日齊射逾百發，以數量壓住城鎮；反坦克伏擊專挑梅卡瓦；九月中更在邊境公路以卡車炸伏擊以軍巡邏隊。雙方的勝負手都在情報與射擊諸元：以軍靠無人機與直升機找出發射位再呼叫砲火，卻因目標分散而收效有限；軍方戰後檢討指出，以軍十七萬發砲彈只摧毀約一百個卡秋莎發射架，大量砲彈在後期因為沒有目標可用而陷入短缺。
tacticsEn: Israeli method was the classic three-stage combination of fire in depth and a ground advance. The first stage was the fire preparation: on the bright afternoon of 12 July Hezbollah struck across the line at the Shebaa Farms, and Israel answered that same evening with border artillery and air strikes; in the small hours of the following day the air force ran the operation code-named Density, which by Israeli account destroyed fifty-nine medium-range rocket launchers in thirty-four minutes, followed in the next days by the destruction of large numbers of Zelzal-2 missiles. The eighty-three targets intelligence had prepared before the war were all struck by the fourth day. The second stage was the ground advance: infantry working with armour, pushing in along the Blue Line into the depth of the south, fighting village by village with Hezbollah around Maroun al-Ras, taking two Hezbollah fighters prisoner on the twenty-fourth before pushing on towards the Litani. The third stage was the large ground offensive launched even in the last days before the ceasefire, which the Winograd Commission faulted for never having chosen between an option and a way out. Hezbollah's method was dispersal, mobility and guerrilla action: trucks used as launchers, fired and immediately broken down; massed rocket fire of more than a hundred rounds a day to batter the towns; anti-tank ambushes aimed squarely at the Merkava; and in mid-September a truck bomb on a border road against an Israeli patrol. The deciding factor on both sides was intelligence and fire discipline: Israel used unmanned aircraft and helicopters to find the launchers and then called fire on them, but achieved little against targets so dispersed; the post-war IDF review concluded that of the 170,000 shells fired only about one hundred Katyusha launchers were destroyed, and that towards the end of the war a serious ammunition shortage built up simply because there were no targets left to shoot at.
data: 可核對的數字集中在火力與裝備這一邊。以軍空軍在本役執行一萬一千八百九十七次戰鬥任務，超過一九七三年十月戰爭的一萬一千二百二十三次，接近一九八二年黎巴嫩戰爭六千零五十二次的兩倍；地面砲兵發射十七萬發砲彈，是一九七三年戰役的兩倍以上，海軍另射二千五百發。集束彈方面，以軍在南黎投下四百六十萬枚集束彈藥，分佈在九百六十二次打擊中，其中約九成集中在停火生效前的最後七十二小時；真主黨亦以Type-81與Type-90集束火箭彈向以色列北部發射四千四百零七枚集束彈藥，共一一三次襲擊。火箭砲數量上，真主黨全役共發射三千九百七十至四千二百二十八枚火箭，平均每日逾百發，其中約九成半是122毫米「卡秋莎」，彈頭最大約三十公斤，射程可達三十公里，約百分之二十三落在城鎮與建成區。以軍損失：陣亡一百二十一名國防軍人員，國防軍一千二百四十四人受傷，二十輛坦克被擊毀，一架直升機被擊落、另三架因事故損失，一架F-16起飛時墜毀，三架無人機失事；以軍估計擊斃真主黨武裝人員六百人以上，軍方情報部門十一月估六百五十人，人權觀察組織則只認二百五十人。真主黨方面，阿慕拉運動十七人、黎巴嫩共產黨十二人、巴勒斯坦解放組織人民鬥爭總部二人、黎巴嫩軍與內部安全部隊四十三人陣亡。經濟代價上，黎巴嫩直接與間接損失約五十億美元，約佔二〇〇六年國內生產總值百分之二十二，成長率由百分之六跌到百分之二；以軍方面的戰爭開支估計約三十五億美元。戰後部署在南黎的是黎巴嫩軍一萬五千人與聯合國駐黎部隊一萬二千人。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around firepower and matériel. The Israeli Air Force flew 11,897 combat missions in this campaign, more than the 11,223 of the October War of 1973 and close to twice the 6,052 of the Lebanon War of 1982; the army artillery fired 170,000 shells, more than double the expenditure of 1973, and the navy added 2,500 rounds. On cluster munitions, Israel dropped 4.6 million submunitions into southern Lebanon across 962 separate strikes, about ninety per cent of them in the final seventy-two hours before the ceasefire took effect; Hezbollah answered with Type-81 and Type-90 cluster rockets against northern Israel, firing 4,407 submunitions in 113 attacks. On the rocket artillery count, Hezbollah fired between 3,970 and 4,228 rockets over the campaign, more than a hundred a day, roughly ninety-five per cent of them 122 mm Katyusha with warheads of up to about thirty kilograms and a range of up to thirty kilometres, and about twenty-three per cent of them landed in towns and built-up areas. Israeli losses: 121 IDF personnel killed and 1,244 IDF personnel wounded, twenty tanks destroyed, one helicopter shot down and three lost in accidents, one F-16 written off on take-off and three unmanned aircraft lost to accidents; Israel estimated that more than six hundred Hezbollah fighters were killed, its military intelligence directorate put the figure at six hundred and fifty in November, while human rights monitors counted only two hundred and fifty. On the Hezbollah side, seventeen members of the Amal Movement, twelve of the Lebanese Communist Party, two of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command and forty-three Lebanese Armed Forces and Internal Security Forces personnel were killed. In economic terms, Lebanon's direct and indirect losses came to about five billion US dollars, roughly twenty-two per cent of 2006 gross domestic product, with growth falling from six per cent to two per cent, while the war is estimated to have cost Israel about three and a half billion dollars. The force deployed in the south after the war was fifteen thousand Lebanese soldiers and twelve thousand UNIFIL troops.
cause: 導火線是七月十二日真主黨在舍巴農莊一帶對以色列邊境巡邏隊的跨境襲擊，擊斃三名以軍並擄走兩名士兵，隨後的營救行動又折損五名以軍。背景則是二〇〇〇年以色列撤出南黎、二〇〇五年敘利亞撤軍之後的權力真空：真主黨接管南部山區，以色列在二〇〇四年的換俘交易中放走三名真主黨人，卻認定另一名被扣的黎巴嫩人早已陣亡，家屬不滿，交易因而破裂。以色列內閣把擄人視為恐怖主義跨境襲擊，十二日深夜即決定以大規模軍事行動回應，把行動目標定為摧毀真主黨在南部的存在。溫諾格拉德委員會的調查指出，以軍是在尚未決定終局方案、也沒有退出策略的情況下投入戰爭的，可選的方案只有「短促而疼痛的打擊」與「以大規模地面行動改變南部現狀」兩個，而答案直到停火前夕都未定案。真主黨方面則主張行動是對以色列違約的回應，納斯魯拉在二〇〇六年八月的訪問中說，若早知擄人會引來這場戰爭就不會執行，又說整場戰爭其實早已在計畫中，七月動手只是把時間提前。
causeEn: The trigger was the Hezbollah cross-border raid of 12 July against an Israeli border patrol at the Shebaa Farms, which killed three Israelis and took two soldiers captive, with a follow-up rescue attempt costing another five Israeli lives. The background was the vacuum left after the Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon in 2000 and the Syrian departure in 2005: Hezbollah took over the southern hills, and in the 2004 prisoner exchange Israel released three Hezbollah men while maintaining that another Lebanese man it held had long been dead, an account his family refused, so the deal collapsed. The Israeli cabinet treated the seizure as a terrorist cross-border attack and on the night of the twelfth decided to answer it with large-scale military action, setting the destruction of Hezbollah's presence in the south as the object of the campaign. The Winograd Commission found that Israel went to war without having decided the end-state and without an exit strategy; the only two options on the table were a short, painful blow or a large ground operation that would change the reality of the south, and the choice was still unmade on the eve of the ceasefire. Hezbollah's own account was that the raid answered an Israeli default. Nasrallah said in an interview in August 2006 that he would not have carried out the seizure had he known it would trigger this war, and that the war itself had long been planned, with July merely bringing the date forward.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響主要落在三條線上。以色列方面，北部邊境在二〇〇六年底之前維持了中東前線最長的一段平靜，以軍得以把南部前線交給黎巴嫩軍與聯合國部隊，邊境不再像一九八二年那樣由以軍主動經營；代價卻是溫諾格拉德報告造成的政治地震，總理奧爾默特在二〇〇六年十一月辭職，國防部長佩雷茨與參謀長哈魯茲相繼去位，戰爭開支與北部重建的財政負擔延續到往後數年。真主黨方面，這一仗把一個被以色列與部分阿拉伯國家視為外國武裝代理人的組織，變成抵抗運動的象徵，什葉派地區的支持上升，其後在二〇〇八年五月的南部選舉中擊敗對手聯盟，再在同年的黎巴嫩總統選舉中取得關鍵票數，成為能左右國家政策的政治力量。區域格局上，安理會一七〇一號決議確立了南部的現狀：真主黨不被解除武裝、黎巴嫩軍不被允許對其動武、聯合國部隊在南部建立存在，這條架構一直維持到二〇一〇年前後才被逐步侵蝕。軍備層面上，本役證明情報準備與射擊諸元比火力總量更決定成敗，也推動以色列其後把無人機、定點清除與火箭攔截系統排上優先次序，聯合國維和部隊在南部清出的火箭殘骸與未爆彈，也成為二〇〇七年之後清理工作的主體。
impactEn: The consequences of this war ran along three lines. For Israel, the northern border enjoyed the longest stretch of quiet on the Middle East fronts until the end of 2006, and the army could hand the southern line over to the Lebanese Armed Forces and the UN force rather than run it itself as it had done since 1982; the price was the political earthquake caused by the Winograd report, with Prime Minister Olmert resigning in November 2006, Defense Minister Peretz and Chief of Staff Halutz leaving in turn, and the cost of the campaign and of rebuilding the north weighing on the budget for years afterwards. For Hezbollah, the war turned an organisation that Israel and several Arab states treated as a proxy for a foreign armed force into the emblem of resistance, with support rising in the Shiite districts, and it went on to defeat the opposing lists in the southern elections of May 2008 and to supply the decisive votes in that year's presidential election, becoming a political force able to steer national policy. At the regional level, Security Council Resolution 1701 set the terms of the south: Hezbollah was not to be disarmed, the Lebanese Army was not permitted to use force against it, and a United Nations presence was established in the south, an arrangement that held until it was gradually eroded around 2010. On the materiel level, the campaign showed that intelligence preparation and fire discipline mattered more than the sheer weight of firepower, and pushed Israel afterwards to prioritise unmanned aircraft, precision removal and rocket interception; the rocket debris and unexploded ordnance cleared by the UN peacekeepers in the south formed the bulk of the clearance work after 2007.
result: 二〇〇六年八月十一日聯合國安理會一致通過一七〇一號決議，十四日晨停火生效，黎巴嫩軍自十七日起進駐南部，聯合國駐黎部隊擴編至一萬二千人；海上與空中封鎖在九月七日與八日先後解除，以軍主力在十月一日撤出黎境，只留下橫跨邊界的加哈爾村據點至今未撤。真主黨的火箭砲攻擊在停火後大幅收斂，但南部前線的實權仍留在真主黨手中，黎巴嫩軍與聯合國部隊只能進駐利塔尼河以南，推進工作一直拖到二〇〇九年之後才慢慢往北。以軍並未達成解除真主黨武裝的目標，溫諾格拉德委員會因此把此役定性為以色列的錯失機會，認為以軍既沒有明確目標也沒有退出策略，最後仍靠決議收場；真主黨同樣沒有達成摧毀以色列北部屏障的目標，火箭發射架損失有限，南部補給線卻被情報戰與定點清除嚴重打斷，戰後重建所需的物資與資金同樣斷裂。兩邊都宣布勝利，這是本役最常被記錄的結局：以色列政府把一七〇一號決議視為成果，納斯魯拉則宣稱神聖勝利，並稱手上仍存有兩萬枚火箭。被擄的兩名以軍士兵遺骸直到二〇〇八年七月才隨換俘協議送回以色列，這場戰役才算真正落幕。
resultEn: On 11 August 2006 the Security Council adopted Resolution 1701 unanimously, the ceasefire took effect on the morning of the fourteenth, the Lebanese Army began deploying into the south on the seventeenth, and UNIFIL was expanded to twelve thousand men. The air and naval blockades were lifted on 7 and 8 September, the bulk of the Israeli forces pulled out of Lebanon on 1 October, and only the border-straddling village of Ghajar remains occupied to this day. Hezbollah's rocket campaign collapsed sharply after the ceasefire, but operational control of the southern line stayed in Hezbollah's hands, and the Lebanese Army and the UN force could only hold the area south of the Litani, with the advance north dragging on until after 2009. Israel did not achieve the disarmament of Hezbollah, and the Winograd Commission accordingly called the campaign a missed opportunity, finding that Israel had neither clear objectives nor an exit strategy and had ended the war on a resolution; Hezbollah equally failed to break the barrier in the north, kept most of its launchers, but saw its supply lines in the south badly cut by intelligence work and precision removal, and the matériel and money for postwar reconstruction were just as broken. Both sides declared victory, which is the most recorded ending of the campaign: the Israeli government treated Resolution 1701 as an achievement, while Nasrallah claimed a divine victory and said he still held twenty thousand rockets. The remains of the two captured Israeli soldiers were only returned to Israel in July 2008 as part of the prisoner exchange, and only then did the campaign truly come to an end.
